input.content:
Record the MySQL validation of e2806bd in the job-queue docs

Commit e2806bd (milestone 2) was run against MySQL 8.4.13 and Kafka
4.3.1 on fresh containers on 2026-10-23. The complete job-test set gave
379 passed, none failed or skipped, with 162 cases on each store.

Until now, the docs gave only an earlier revision's MySQL result, from
before the job-id validation (353 passed). docs/job-queue.md now gives
both results, separately. Its offline and Kafka-only results for this
revision, and the whole-suite run of an earlier revision, are
unchanged.

spec §11's single-run memory ranges now cover three runs: 324–398 MiB
for MySQL and 354–478 MiB for Kafka, of which the run of e2806bd gave
398 and 478 MiB. The long-session caveat is unchanged: MySQL reached
511 of its 512 MiB over about two hours of repeated runs. That shows
limited headroom, and it is not evidence that longer runs stay within
the limit.

Documentation only; no code changes.
